programme.desc: Liverpool have only lost two of 33 previous home league games against Fulham, 1-0 defeats in May 2012 and March 2021. Since completing the double over Liverpool in 2011-12, Fulham have won just two of 16 Premier League games versus the Reds.

programme.title: Arsenal v Chelsea - English Premier League 2026/2027
programme.desc: Arsenal are unbeaten in their last nine Premier League matches against Chelsea, their best unbeaten run against the Blues since a run of 19 between 1995 and 2005. Chelsea have lost their last four away Premier League games against Arsenal by an aggregate score of 11-2. Their last win there was in August 2021, a 2-0 victory.

programme.title: Sunderland v Arsenal - English Premier League 2026/2027
programme.desc: Sunderland have won just one of their last 29 Premier League meetings with Arsenal, and are winless in 17 since a 1-0 victory in November 2009 after Darren Bent’s goal. Arsenal have only lost one of their last 14 league visits to Sunderland, winning five of their last seven, although did draw this exact fixture last season 2-2.

programme.title: Ipswich Town v Liverpool - English Premier League 2026/2027
programme.desc: Ipswich Town have lost their last four Premier League games against Liverpool across the 2001-02 and 2024-25 seasons, conceding 17 goals and scoring just once. Liverpool are unbeaten in all six away Premier League matches against Ipswich Town at Portman Road. It’s the most games they’ve played at one stadium without losing in the competition.
